title: Config
description: Config is the router configuration file.

$schema.description: Editor hint pointing at `config.schema.json`. Accepted and ignored.

network.description: Outbound network options shared by every route.

AuthConfig.description: AuthConfig controls which credential reaches the upstream.

token.description: Credential template: literal text with `{env:NAME}` and `{file:PATH}` placeholders.

NetworkConfig.description: NetworkConfig describes how the router reaches its upstreams.

ca_file.description:
PEM bundle added to the native root store. Empty disables it.
Supports `{env:NAME}` and `{file:PATH}` templates.

proxy.description:
Outbound HTTP proxy (`http://` only); CONNECT is used for every upstream.
Empty disables the proxy. Supports `{env:NAME}` and `{file:PATH}` templates.

QuotaConfig.description: QuotaConfig describes an upstream quota endpoint authenticated with the route credential.

RouteConfig.description: RouteConfig describes one upstream and the models it serves.

count_tokens_model.description: Replaces the model on /v1/messages/count_tokens when set.

drop_fields.description: Top-level request body fields removed on /v1/messages*.

drop_headers.description: Headers removed from requests sent upstream (e.g. anthropic-beta).

drop_tool_fields.description: Fields removed from every entry of the request "tools" array.

models.description: Glob patterns: "*" matches any sequence, including "/".

quota.description: Optionally polls an upstream quota endpoint and exports it as metrics.

rewrite.description: Maps an incoming model ID to the ID sent upstream. Keys also match the route.

set_fields.description:
Top-level request body fields set on /v1/messages*. Values support the same
templates as `auth.token`; the expansion is parsed as JSON, falling back to a string.

set_headers.description: Request headers set before forwarding. Values support `{env:NAME}` and `{file:PATH}`.

strip_prefix.description: Removed from the model ID sent upstream (e.g. "nano:"). Rewrite wins.

SanitizeConfig.description: SanitizeConfig groups request-body relaxations for upstreams with a stricter validator.

drop_metadata_user_id.description: Removes `metadata.user_id`, which some upstreams validate as `^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$`.

hoist_inline_tools.description:
Moves mid-conversation `tool_addition` definitions into the top-level `tools` array,
for upstreams without the `inline-tools` beta. `tool_removal` blocks are dropped.

sanitize_tool_use_ids.description: Rewrites `tool_use.id` and `tool_result.tool_use_id` to Anthropic's allowed charset.

ToolSchemaConfig.description: ToolSchemaConfig relaxes tool input schemas for backends with a restricted validator.

drop_pattern.description: Remove the `pattern` keyword outright. Wins over the two rewrites.

normalize_nul_escape.description: Rewrite the `\0` NUL escape to `\x00` in every `pattern`.

string_formats.description: String `format` values to keep. Absent keeps every format.

strip_lookaround.description: Remove zero-width lookaround assertions from every `pattern`.
